chapter.verse: Mi gentheite a khual mi in thupha ngah ahi hi. Topa in haksatna hunah amah honkhia hi.
Topa in amah hu-in hingsak hi; leitungah amah thupha ngah mipa kici hi; ama galte’ deihna-ah amah na piakhia kei hi.
ci na-a a lupna tungah Topa in amah na kem a, a ci nat ciangin ama gitlohna khempeuh na damsak hi.
Ke’n ahih leh, “ Topa aw, kei hong hehpih in; keimah hong damsak in, bang hang hiam cih leh nang tungah kong khial zo hi!” ka ci hi.
Ka galte in elna tawh keima thu gen uh a: “Cik ciangin amah a si tam, cik ciangin ama min a mang tam?” ci uh hi.
Keimah en dingin mi hong pai ciangin, kam mawkna pau uh hi, a lung sungah siatna kaikhawm uh a, a paikhiat uh ciangin genthang uh hi.
Kei hong mudah khempeuh in keima thu kihuauhuau uh a, kei’ adingin a sia thei pen gelgel uh hi.
Amaute in, “Thusia khat ama tungah baang zo hi; a lupna panin thokik nawn lo ding hi,” ci uh hi.
Ka muan’, ka lawm itpa, keima an a nepa nangawn in, a khetul tawh keimah hong peek hi.
Ahih hangin, Topa aw, amaute ka thukkik theih nadingin kei hong hehpih in la, hong phong to in!
Ka galte in keimah hong zawh lohna thu-ah, keima tungah nong lungkimna ka thei hi.
Ahih hangin keima kicin’na hangin nong huh a, nangma omna-ah kei nong koih den hi.
Israel Pasian, Topa in khang tawntungin thupha ngah ta hen! Amen, Amen.
